# Archy Agents developer documentation

> Archy Agents is a multi-tenant platform for RAG, AI agents, multi-agent workflows and an MCP server. These docs explain how to integrate with and build on it.

Machine-readable entry points:

- [OpenAPI specification](https://architechcro.github.io/archy-agents-docs/openapi.json): every public endpoint and schema
- [Full text of the guides](https://architechcro.github.io/archy-agents-docs/llms-full.txt): guides, tutorials, MCP and concepts in one file
